description: Get one rental's status and connection details (Jupyter URL + token). After create_rental, call this to get the URL. It WAITS internally (up to ~24s) for the rental to finish coming up and returns as soon as it's ready — so you usually only need ONE call, at most two. Do NOT call it repeatedly in a tight loop. Provisioning plus the secure tunnel take ~20-40 seconds total; the URL is ready when connection_pending is false. Read-only.
name: get_rental
